pages.text: $(l)Small Ships$() brings real sailing ships: the sturdy $(l:travel/ships#dockyard)Cog$(/l) and Brigg, the oared Galley, the Dhow, and the shield-hung Drakkar.

Ships are raised at a $(l:travel/ships#dockyard)Dockyard$(/l) by the water. Feed it materials and it builds the hull. $(l:travel/ships#cotton_sails)Cotton Sails$(/l) and other fittings go on there too. Mount $(l:travel/ships#cannon)Cannons$(/l) and keep $(l:travel/ships#cannon_ball)Cannon Balls$(/l) aboard. Mind the wind and your cargo.
On land, $(l)Steam 'n' Rails$() gives Create trains new tracks, bogeys and $(l:travel/ships#fuel_tank)Fuel Tanks$(/l).
Mounts on the side of a ship.
